description: Apple on Tuesday launched a refreshed version of its 24-inch iMac. The all-in-one desktop computer now comes with the M6 chip, which is Apple’s first computing platform fabricated using the 2nm process technology. It sports a 24-inch 4.5K Retina display. Like all of its recent computers that are powered by an Apple Silicon chipset, the new 24-inch iMac supports the new Apple Intelligence features, including Siri AI, running on macOS 27 Golden Gate.
title: iMac (2026) With M6 Chip, 4.5K Retina Display and Apple Intelligence Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: Apple has launched the new MacBook Pro (2026) in India, bringing multiple upgrades to the flagship laptop lineup. The new MacBook Pro (2026) is currently available for pre-order. It is scheduled to go on sale in India on November 6 via the Apple India online store. The laptop is offered in Space Black and Silver colour options. It is powered by the M6 chipset, which features a 12-core CPU. It is the tech giant’s first SoC built on the 2nm process. The new M6 configuration is only available with the 14-inch model. The laptop has been upgraded to an OLED display.
title: MacBook Pro (2026) Launched in India With 14-Inch OLED Display, Apple’s M6 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Ethereum developers have merged a fix for a Glamsterdam upgrade vulnerability that could have redirected staking deposits to block builders under certain conditions. Researcher Avsetsin identified the issue while examining deposit mechanisms used by Lido, Origin, and Rocket Pool. The patch has been incorporated into Ethereum’s consensus specifications but still requires implementation by client teams. Glamsterdam testing on Hoodi also remains delayed following a separate smart contract risk assessment.
title: Ethereum Resolves Glamsterdam Bug That Could Have Redirected Staking Deposits

description: X has introduced a new on-screen prompt that directs users towards the Promote button while they are composing posts. The new graphics are drawing confusion and criticism from users on the social media platform. The feature displays a large pointing hand on the screen, encouraging users to consider promoting their content. Many users have shared screenshots of the unexpected prompt.
title: X Appears to Be Nudging Users to Pay to Promote Posts With a Giant Hand Graphic

description: The iQOO Neo 12 scored 3,172 points in Geekbench's single-core test and 10,689 points in its multi-core test, while the iQOO Pad Pro recorded 3,118 and 10,523 points, respectively. Both devices are listed with Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and Android 17. The smartphone is expected to feature a 9,000mAh battery, 100W charging and a 185Hz display, while the tablet could offer an 8.8-inch 165Hz OLED screen and a 9,020mAh battery.
title: iQOO Neo 12, iQOO Pad Pro With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC Spotted on Geekbench Ahead of Launch

description: Binance has applied for a cryptocurrency service provider licence in Brazil through its local affiliate ahead of an October 30 regulatory deadline. The exchange aims to expand beyond digital asset trading by offering financial services such as bill payments, international transfers and foreign exchange transactions. Binance has also reorganised its Brazilian operations to separate cryptocurrency activities from traditional financial services as it prepares to operate under Central Bank of Brazil supervision.
title: Binance Pursues Brazilian Regulatory Approval Ahead of October 30 Deadline

description: Anthropic's evaluation of Mythos 5 revealed multiple cases of the AI model acting beyond the intended scope of cybersecurity tests. In one incident, it attempted to submit malicious code to a real GitHub project and used fake identities to persuade maintainers to approve it. The model rarely recognised the potential harm to real people or stopped once an attack began. Anthropic also found that newer models were less likely to attempt the same attack, while the UK AI Security Institute tightened evaluation controls.
title: Anthropic Says Mythos 5 Used Fake Identities to Get Malicious Code Approved on GitHub

description: Konami and Bloober Team are reportedly targeting a 2027 launch for Silent Hil remake. The horror title was announced last year, but does not have a release date yet. A new report has claimed the remake is planned for launch next year and also revealed two cast members involved with the project. Bloober Team previously developed the acclaimed remake of Silent Hill 2.
title: Bloober Team's Silent Hill Remake Is Reportedly Targeting Launch in 2027

description: WhatsApp's upcoming Android settings redesign introduces rounded containers that group related options together, replacing the existing flat list. The interface was spotted in beta version 2.26.43.3 on the Google Play Store. The new layout uses Google's Material Design 3 Expressive segmented list style, with corner shapes that vary according to each item's position within a group. The redesign is expected to extend across settings pages, including Account, Privacy and Notifications. WhatsApp is also developing changes to its navigation bar and chat bar.
title: WhatsApp Is Reportedly Working on a New Settings Menu for Android Users

description: Tech stocks in China have crashed as lofty valuations collapse under worries about AI demand and curbs on Chinese exports. The meltdown, tanking the mainland STAR50 index of AI and semiconductor leaders by 40 percent in less than four months and vaporising some $480 billion in market value, is an ill omen for wobbly world markets and a dampener on China's efforts at encouraging its savers into stocks to fund the AI boom.
title: In China, the AI Bubble Has Already Burst

description: Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) Series will be launched in India on November 5 at 12 pm IST, the company announced on Tuesday. The company has also announced that the Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) Series will be available for purchase in India in Arctic Blue, Komodo Coral, and Zabriskie Beige colour options. Asus will also provide Easy Pay financing solutions to offer no-cost EMI options starting at Rs. 7,333 per month for up to 18 months. The Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) Series is confirmed to weigh about 1.1kg. The laptop will measure about 1.39mm in terms of thickness. The Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) Series is also claimed to provide up to 33 hours of battery life. The new laptop lineup will boast Asus’ Ceraluminum build, which is a combination of aluminium and ceramic.
title: Asus Zenbook 14 (2026) Series India Launch Date Announced Along With Key Specifications, Colour Options

description: Apple's iPhone 18e is tipped to feature a 6.12-inch LTPS OLED display with a 60Hz refresh rate and a 2nm A20 chipset. A tipster claims the phone will retain a single 48-megapixel rear camera, while its front camera could get a 24-megapixel sensor. An earlier leak also pointed to 9GB of RAM, up from 8GB on the iPhone 17e. Apple has yet to confirm the specifications, pricing or launch date of its expected 2027 handset.
title: iPhone 18e Key Specifications Leaked Again: Expected Display, SoC, Camera Details

description: Canada has opened a 60-day public consultation on proposed regulations for stablecoin issuers that are not financial institutions, with feedback accepted until December 23. The framework includes restrictions on yield payments, redemption requirements, and limits on transaction fees. The proposed rules aim to align Canada’s approach with international frameworks and are expected to take effect in fall 2027, after which eligible issuers would need to register with the Bank of Canada.
title: Canada Invites Feedback on Stablecoin Rules Following US GENIUS Act

description: Free Fire India (FFI) will be available to download in India from October 28, 2026, Garena announced on Tuesday. The battle royale game will be released as a standalone application on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. The launch kicks off with an exclusive Diwali event running until 15 November. Free Fire India is confirmed to include parental consent requirements for users under 18.
title: Free Fire India Launch Date Set for October 28; Confirmed to Feature Parental Controls, Playtime Limits

description: Oppo Find X10 Forest Green Edition pricing and availability details have been announced by the smartphone maker. The phone costs the same as the standard edition model and has the same specifications and features. The Oppo Find X10 Forest Green Edition has been designed in collaboration with the New York-based German illustrator, Karlotta Freier. The smartphone is now available for pre-order via the Oppo China online store. It is scheduled to go on sale in the country on October 30. The Forest Green Edition of the Oppo Find X10 will not be available in the 16GB + 1TB configuration, which is priced at CNY 7,499 (about Rs. 1,07,000). Moreover, the company has yet to reveal whether the colour option will be launched in India.
title: Oppo Find X10 Forest Green Edition Pricing and Availability Details Announced: Specifications, Features

description: Sucker Punch has reportedly been hit with layoffs just weeks after the launch on Ghost of Yotei Complete Edition. According to a report, the studio has laid off 24 employees. In an email to staff, the studio reportedly said it decided to make the cuts after reviewing the requirements for its next project.
title: Sucker Punch Hit With Layoffs Weeks After the Launch of Ghost of Yotei Complete Edition

description: GPT-6.1 Terra AI model was released by OpenAI on Tuesday as its latest GPT-6.1 series model. The Sam Altman-led AI giant has announced that its GPT-6.1 Terra AI model is now available to all Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users. Subscribers can access the latest AI model in ChatGPT Work and Codex. Apart from this, OpenAI says that developers can access GPT-6.1 Terra via the OpenAI API. According to OpenAI, the GPT-6.1 Terra AI model brings improvements over GPT-5.6 Terra in terms of communication and computer-based tasks, like drafting proposals, interpreting technical drawings, filling out forms, and editing videos. On the Agents’ Last Exam benchmark test, which tests an AI model’s computer-use capabilities, GPT-6.1 Terra scored 15 percentage points higher than its predecessor at medium reasoning effort, at one-third the cost per million tokens.
title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6.1 Terra AI Model With Cost Efficiency, Software Engineering Capabilities Improvements Over GPT-5.6 Terra

description: Apple's iPad mini (2026) starts at Rs. 82,900 in India, up Rs. 33,000 from the previous model's launch price. It features an 8.5-inch OLED display, the A20 Pro chip, Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6.0, along with 35W wired charging and an IP67 rating. The iPad mini (2024) has an 8.3-inch Liquid Retina IPS display and an A17 Pro chip. Both tablets offer up to 512GB of storage and 12-megapixel rear cameras.
title: New iPad Mini (2026) vs iPad Mini (2024): What's New

description: Vivo X500s could launch soon. Ahead of the official announcement, a tipster has suggested its display details. The engineering sample of the phone reportedly features a 6.85-inch 2K+ display with a refresh rate of up to 144Hz. The panel is also described as a quad-sided flat screen. This would represent an upgrade over the Vivo X300s. The latter came with a 6.78-inch AMOLED display with 1.5K resolution and a 144Hz refresh rate.
title: Vivo X500s May Feature 6.85-Inch Display With 144Hz Refresh Rate, Tipster Claims

description: Vodafone Idea (Vi) has raised the price of its most affordable plan that offers 84 days of validity and 5G connectivity. The prepaid plan now costs Rs. 899, which marks a price hike of Rs. 40, while offering the same benefits. Vi’s Rs. 899 prepaid plan offers 5G data and a 1.5GB per day data quota. As previously mentioned, the plan has a validity of 84 days. Moreover, subscribers get unlimited calling. With the Rs. 899 recharge pack, the telecom company offers a “free night data” benefit, which allows subscribers to use 5G data between midnight and 6 am, during which there are no deductions made from the user’s daily allowance. Moreover, the plan offers weekend data rollover and up to 2GB of backup Data every month, at no additional cost. Subscribers can claim this benefit via the Vi App.
title: Vodafone Idea (Vi) Silently Raises Price of Its Rs. 859 Prepaid Plan With 84-Day Validity

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max have reportedly been spotted on a retailer's website in the EU, hinting at an imminent global launch. The Xiaomi 18 Pro series handsets were reportedly spotted in the Black, Velvet Red, and White colour options. In terms of pricing, the Xiaomi 18 Pro was reportedly listed at a starting price of EUR 1,398.9 (roughly Rs. 1,50,000) for the base model with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. Meanwhile, the higher-end 12GB + 512GB RAM and storage configuration was listed at EUR 1,591.9 (about Rs. 1,69,000). On the other hand, the top-of-the-line Xiaomi 18 Pro Max was listed at EUR 1,783.9 (roughly Rs. 1,89,000) for the sole 12GB + 512GB model.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max Global Pricing, Key Specifications Revealed via Retailer Listing

description: Truecaller Lite was launched in India on Tuesday as a lite version of the caller identification app. According to the company, it is designed for Android smartphones with limited storage and memory. Truecaller Lite is claimed to retain all of the essential features of the full-fledged app. This includes caller ID, spam and fraud call blocking, call history, contacts, and number search. However, it occupies only about 10MB of storage and can run on devices with up to 4GB of RAM.
title: Truecaller Lite Launched in India With Caller ID for Android Phones With Limited Storage

description: Bitcoin is trading near $79,700 as traders assess interest-rate expectations, elevated oil prices, and mixed institutional demand. Strategy has paused further Bitcoin accumulation and is allocating nearly $205 million to preferred-share buybacks. Meanwhile, Ethereum ETFs recorded inflows even as Bitcoin ETFs saw no net flows on October 26.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $80,000 as Strategy Pauses Bitcoin Purchases

description: OnePlus Ace 7 Pro will feature a 200-megapixel primary rear camera and a periscope telephoto camera with 3.5x optical zoom. The OnePlus Ace 7 will be offered in three memory and storage configurations, while the Pro variant will come in five RAM and storage options. Both smartphones are also confirmed to feature BOE displays with a 165Hz refresh rate and support for up to 185Hz in select games. The OnePlus Ace 7 and OnePlus Ace 7 Pro will be launched in China on October 29.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Pro Camera Details Revealed Ahead of October 29 Launch

description: The Vivo X500 series was launched in China last month and is expected to make its global debut soon. While the company has yet to officially reveal any details about the India debut of its flagship lineup, industry sources suggest that the lineup will arrive in the country by the end of next month. The Vivo X500 Pro Max is expected to lead the lineup with advanced camera-centric features, which could include 60fps autofocus tracking for snapshot photography.
title: Vivo X500 Series India Launch Expected in November; X500 Pro Max Camera Details Surface
Festive Season Laptop Deals 2026: Explore Best Deals on AI Laptops on Amazon

description: Motorola Edge 70 Neo specifications and colour options have leaked. The phone is tipped to feature a 7,000mAh battery and a 144Hz display. It could run on a Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset and a 50-megapixel Sony LYTIA camera. It could feature a 32-megapixel camera for selfies and video calls. The Motorola Edge 70 Neo is said to pack a 7,000mAh battery with support for 45W charging.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo Colour Options, Specifications Leaked Ahead of India Launch

description: Microsoft is offering a Voluntary Exit Offer (VEO) to “some” employees in the US, India, the UK, and Canada, Microsoft’s Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer, Amy Coleman, announced on Monday. Further, the company executive said that Microsoft employees with an experience level of 70 or below are eligible for the voluntary exit package, which will include multiple pay components. Microsoft says that the VEO is a “time-limited” programme, allowing eligible employees to leave the tech giant “with financial support and career planning resources”. Coleman writes, “Participation varies based on each business’s priorities, customer commitments and workforce needs.”
title: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Exit Buyout to About 60,000 Employees Amid Massive AI Infrastructure Push

description: Instagram has begun testing Features, a long-form video format, with select US creators following earlier trials in Brazil. The feature lets creators link short Reels to horizontal videos lasting up to 90 minutes, with recommendations appearing across the app. Instagram plans to expand the test to more creators and is exploring TV viewing options. It is also working on brand deals but has yet to outline a revenue-sharing model. Separate tests cover episodic Reels through Series and improved Instagram Live discovery.
title: Instagram Tests Long-Form Videos With Features, Taking on YouTube’s Content Format

description: Call of Duty has surpassed $40 billion in lifetime franchise revenue, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma confirmed after the launch of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Sharma congratulated Activision for the successful launch of the game and said Modern Warfare 4 was "one of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history."
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Launch Pushes Franchise Past $40 Billion Lifetime Revenue

description: Apple released the iOS 27.2 update for iPhone on Monday. It is the second major iteration of the latest iPhone operating system, which was first rolled out in September alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The update brings several new features, including new features and more languages for Siri AI. Users can also access contextual suggestions in Messages, which allow them to take quick actions in apps like Calendar and Reminders. The Cupertino-based tech giant patched several security vulnerabilities as well.
title: iOS 27.2 Update Rolls Out With New Siri AI Features, Contextual Messages Suggestions and More

description: Infinix GT 50 Pro has been launched in India. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate chipset and has a 6,500mAh battery. Infinix GT 50 Pro runs Android 16-based XOS 16. It features a 6.78-inch LTPS AMOLED display with a 1.5K resolution. As part of the launch offer, the company is offering the GT 50 Pro Gaming Ecosystem worth Rs. 24,999 free alongside the phone.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro Launched in India With Dimensity 8400 Ultimate, 144Hz Refresh Rate Display: Price, Specifications

description: Motorollers will feature interest-based groups called Tribes, where members can post content and join discussions on topics ranging from gaming and photography to travel and artificial intelligence. The app will include Vibe Check for polls, Hot Take for opinions and Deep Dive for longer articles. Motorola will use dedicated channels to share product announcements, discounts and coupons, while retail partners and promoters will answer product-related questions. The company also plans to introduce rewards and other member benefits in future updates.
title: Motorola Launches Motorollers Community App for Android Users in India

description: Apple finally launched its first foldable iPhone this year. The iPhone Duo is also the most expensive iPhone to date, but it appears to be facing some early teething problems. In recent days, the handset has had to contend with the challenges of adapting iOS to a book-style display, with some early adopters raising concerns about app optimisation. However, a more serious hardware issue appears to be emerging. Users have allegedly reported cracks on the inner display near the hinge, and Apple has now acknowledged the issue.
title: Apple Reportedly Acknowledges iPhone Duo Inner Display Failures After Users Report Cracks

description: Anthropic is said to be facing fresh scrutiny after a cybersecurity startup founded by former US Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) staffers allegedly accessed sensitive internal systems at the company. Cathedral, a months-old startup, reportedly claimed that its researchers used AI agents to exploit vulnerabilities in third-party business software and reach internal data in less than 12 hours. The accessed information reportedly included meeting transcripts, salary details, job offers, and Slack messages discussing advanced AI models.
title: Former DOGE Staffers’ Startup Reportedly Claims to Have Accessed Sensitive Anthropic Data Using AI Agents
